episodes.name: Back in the Saddle
episodes.overview: As Dwight and his crew prepare for the opening of their casino and new weed shop, the law comes knocking.

episodes.name: Kansas City Blues
episodes.overview: A family member from Dwight's past surprises him in Tulsa, meanwhile his newfound success draws attention from the Kansas City Mob.

episodes.name: Oklahoma v. Manfredi
episodes.overview: Dwight has a contentious meeting with Bill Bevilaqua and later finds out his fate in court.

episodes.name: Heroes and Villains
episodes.overview: Dwight and Bodhi explore a new investment opportunity. Meanwhile, Thresher learns how far he can push certain people.

episodes.name: Tilting at Windmills
episodes.overview: Thresher makes a move on Dwight's crew as tensions rise within the New York City Mob family.

episodes.name: Navigator
episodes.overview: Dwight has a sit-down with Kansas City and New York. Tyson tries to make his family proud but it comes at a price.

episodes.name: Life Support
episodes.overview: Dwight and his crew try to identify who's responsible for the recent attack. Power dynamics within the NYC Mob start to shift.

episodes.name: Under New Management
episodes.overview: Bevilaqua prepares for revenge. Thresher and Ming discuss a new arrangement.

episodes.name: Triad
episodes.overview: Margaret gets caught up in the middle of Dwight's business as trouble ensues at Fennario Ranch.

episodes.name: Reconstruction
episodes.overview: Dwight and his crew tie up loose ends as their empire expands.

name: Season 2
overview: In season two, Dwight and his crew continue to build up and defend their growing empire in Tulsa but, just as they get their bearings, they realize that they're not the only ones who want to stake their claim. With looming threats from the Kansas City mob and a very powerful local businessman, Dwight struggles to keep his family and crew safe while keeping track of all his affairs. Plus, he still has unfinished business back in New York.
